title: Contract closure orchestration mini-sheet (renewal pipeline compact)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact operational tracker intended for CS managers and AEs to run a tight renewal cadence for mid-market and enterprise contracts (focused on QBR-ready signals). Lightweight, portable sheet to drop into weekly syncs or QBR prep for a portfolio slice. Not the canonical master but designed for distributed use and consolidation into the renewal rollup.

Column layout (left-to-right):
- Account: customer short name
- ARR (USD): annual recurring revenue tied to the contract line
- Contract End: contract expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Renewal Probability: current probability expressed as decimal (0.00–1.00)
- Confidence Notes: short reason for probability (health, exec buy-in, budget)
- Next Step (by date): immediate action and target date
- Owner: CS/AE primary
- Last Contact: YYYY-MM-DD of last meaningful touch
- Churn Signals: comma-separated quick flags (usage-down, exec-change, open-issues)
- Action Items: checklist bullets for next 30 days (meeting, proposal, legal)
- Escalation: whether flagged for AM/BDR/SalesOps escalation (Y/N)
- Risk Category: High / Medium / Low
- Confidence Score: normalized 0–100 for internal prioritization

Sample rows (10) - compact view:
1) Account: AcmeCloud; ARR: 150000; Contract End: 2026-07-15; Renewal Probability: 0.65; Confidence Notes: active product usage, exec sponsor warmed up; Next Step: Pricing proposal sent - 2026-05-20; Owner: Priya Nair; Last Contact: 2026-05-18; Churn Signals: none; Action Items: (1) finalize addendum (2) follow-up call 5/21; Escalation: N; Risk Category: Low; Confidence Score: 72

6) Account: VertexMedia; ARR: 120000; Contract End: 2026-10-18; Renewal Probability: 0.72; Confidence Notes: good product ROI, procurement slow; Next Step: procurement follow-up - 2026-06-07; Owner: Ethan Li; Last Contact: 2026-05-15; Churn Signals: procurement-delay; Action Items: (1) updated SOW (2) procurement checklist; Escalation: N; Risk Category: Medium; Confidence Score: 70

Formula and scoring notes (informal):
- Renewal Probability is subjective; we normalize with Confidence Score to prioritize outreach.
- Confidence Score = round( (BaseHealthScore * 0.6 + ExecSponsorScore * 0.3 + ContractUrgency * 0.1) * 100 ) where each component is 0–1 assigned by owner. (Use approximate heuristics in column "Confidence Notes" to justify numbers.)
- Quick filter: Risk Category = High if Renewal Probability < 0.5 and ARR > 100k OR churn signal present.

Playbook snippets for next 30 days (drop-in steps):
- High risk (>100k ARR): immediate AE+CS joint call within 5 business days, escalate to SalesOps for legal blockers, send executive briefing note if exec sponsor at risk.
- Medium risk: roadmap-demo + one technical mitigation; schedule QBR with prioritized agenda focused on ROI metrics.
- Low risk: standard renewal sequence: reminder -> invoice -> auto-renew confirmation or upsell pitch.

QBR prep checklist (for accounts in this mini-sheet):
- Pull last 90d usage metrics (Owner)
- Executive one-pager with 3 success metrics (CS)
- Risks and mitigations table (AE + CS)
- Proposed commercial options (pricing + term length)
- Legal or procurement blockers (SalesOps)

Consolidation guidance: This file is intended to be merged weekly into the master renewal rollup. Owners should update "Last Contact" and "Next Step" fields after each touch. Highlight rows for escalation before Tuesday 10:00 PST so AMs can action ahead of the Wed renewal sync.

Open questions / TODOs (note to self):
- Add a column for primary technical contact (we currently track in product but not here).
- Experiment with color-coding export for the sync deck (red/orange/green mapping to Risk Category).
- Validate Confidence Score heuristics with 2-week pilot across 30 accounts.

End of mini-sheet.
